title: The substrate has no activity or check that counts ppid=1 orphaned processes grouped by cgroup/systemd unit. This class
description: The substrate has no activity or check that counts ppid=1 orphaned processes grouped by cgroup/systemd unit. This class of defect (a spawned child surviving its own tracked lifecycle, becoming an untracked orphan) caused a real thermal emergency 2026-08-30 -- 14 orphaned bun test processes were invisible to a concurrency governor that correctly tracked its own slot bookkeeping. A periodic check (count ppid=1 processes per unit's cgroup, alert or auto-reap above a threshold) would have caught this class without an operator manually walking /proc. This is a law-6 followon: 'what activity would detect this class without me.'
